title_short: Gabriela (Haven shelter support) · Never Too Far Gone
headline: She was homeless for four years. Now she works at the shelter, sober, to show others that nobody is ever too far gone.
story: Gabriela was homeless for four years. She has been off the streets and sober for a year and six months, and now she helps others have hope.
She went back to the place where she was broken to shine a light for others. When people are homeless, they get judged; but there is a root behind it.
When a resident gets an apartment or a job, tears of joy come out. Her courage: she didn't let her circumstances decide who she is.
do: Open on her four years and her year and six months sober.
Lower third: Gabriela · Shelter Support, The Haven.
dont: Nothing that dwells on the drug years.
